meta.title: TechNova — AI, App & Web Studio in Damascus

hero.statement: We build AI solutions, apps and web experiences for founders and companies — from Damascus. This page isn't a brochure about our work: it is our work, built to the standard we ship for clients.

about.title: A star is a beginning
about.body: TechNova is a Syrian software & AI studio, founded in Damascus in 2026. A nova is matter under pressure until it ignites into light — and that is how we build: pressure, precision, then light. A new company with an older obsession: software that feels alive.

values.title: Innovation
values.body: We build smart solutions for the future.

values.title: Reliability
values.body: We create dependable and secure solutions.

values.title: Partnership
values.body: We grow with the clients we build for.

contact.title: Talk to NOVA
contact.body: NOVA asks a few sharp questions and turns your idea into a build-ready brief. Every one is read by the team that would build it.
